comment: Overrides for scripts/rust-notices.py: crates linked into the ia-get release binaries that publish no license text, and musl libc, which the musl target links from the Rust toolchain. rust/ holds verbatim upstream files; each reason names its source.

crates.name: objc2
crates.reason: macOS only. Publishes no license file; MIT per Cargo.toml and LICENSE.md in github.com/madsmtm/objc2. Upstream added the MIT text for every crate in the repository as LICENSE-MIT.txt (commit ee9a7ada2131, 2026-03-18); that file is copied verbatim

crates.name: objc2-encode
crates.reason: macOS only. Same repository and terms as objc2 (MIT-only per LICENSE.md); same text

crates.name: block2
crates.reason: macOS only. Same repository and terms as objc2 (MIT-only per LICENSE.md); same text

crates.name: dispatch2
crates.reason: macOS only. Same repository as objc2; 'Zlib OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT' per Cargo.toml and LICENSE.md, MIT chosen; same text

extra.name: musl libc
extra.reason: The x86_64-unknown-linux-musl binary statically links the Rust toolchain's self-contained musl. rustc 1.99.0 builds musl 1.2.5 (src/ci/docker/scripts/musl.sh at tag 1.99.0); COPYRIGHT copied verbatim from musl at tag v1.2.5 (sha256 f9bc4423732350eb0b3f7ed7e91d530298476f8fec0c6c427a1c04ade22655af). Check musl.sh when the stable toolchain changes
